flags.fix: Đất nước rơi vào tình trạng vô chính phủ sau cuộc đảo chính. = The country descended into anarchy after the coup.

flags.why: The normal Vietnamese term for anarchism is “chủ nghĩa vô chính phủ,” as used in this [discussion by Vietnamese anarchists](https://en.theanarchistlibrary.org/library/meo-mun-the-commoner-translating-vo-tri).
flags.fix: Use headword “chủ nghĩa vô chính phủ,” gloss “anarchism,” and example “Cuốn sách này giới thiệu về chủ nghĩa vô chính phủ. = This book is an introduction to anarchism.”

flags.why: The expression disparages someone as idle rather than neutrally describing unemployment, as the [Lạc Việt dictionary](https://tratu.coviet.vn/hoc-tieng-phap/tu-dien/lac-viet/ALL/v%C3%B4%2Bc%C3%B4ng%2Br%E1%BB%93i%2Bngh%E1%BB%81.html) explicitly notes.
Calling someone this belittles them as insignificant, a contemptuous use also identified by [ZIM Dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/vo-danh-tieu-tot-tieng-anh-la-gi).
This is an insulting description of someone as morally despicable, as reflected in the [dictionary entry](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/vo-lai-exLJu7zFyYI6E.html).
